successors.name: Republic of Lithuania
successors.text: Cliopatria's Republic of Lithuania of 1990 (65,346 km2)

ledger.x: 1940, 21 July: "the new People's Seimas declared that the Lithuanian people desired to join the Soviet Union" after the Red Army occupation of 16 June 1940; "On 3 August, a Lithuanian delegation... was dispatched to Moscow to sign the document".
1941, 22 June: "Nazi Germany invaded the USSR and occupied all of Lithuania within a month."
1944, July to October: "the Red Army entered Lithuania once again".
1990, 11 March: Lithuania "declared independence from the Soviet Union on 11 March 1990 under its pre-1940 name, the Republic of Lithuania".

certainty.note: The page gives no border changes; Vilnius and Klaipeda lines and the Belarus adjustments are undated.
